## How to Acknowledge ggseg

If you use ggseg in your research, please cite:

```bibtex
@article{mowinckel2020,
  title={Visualization of Brain Statistics with R Packages ggseg and ggseg3d},
  author={Mowinckel, Athanasia M and Vidal-Pi{\~n}eiro, Didac},
  journal={Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science},
  volume={3},
  number={4},
  pages={466--483},
  year={2020},
  publisher={SAGE Publications}
}
```
:::
